fact: A machine-learning tool that allocates essential medicines to health facilities was piloted in 5 of 16 districts with the National Medical Supplies Agency from May 2023, raised consumption of allocated products by an estimated 19% in treated districts, and was then scaled nationwide, covering an estimated 2 million women and children under five.
title: Improving Access to Essential Medicines via Decision-Aware Machine Learning
publisher: arXiv (Chung, Abdulai, Bayoh, Sandi, Smart, Bastani)
